title: Law to require pet clinics to post prices
summary: This bill would require veterinary care facilities to disclose standard charges or price ranges for common services and post them at the point of purchase. Facilities would need to give written estimates for purchases likely to exceed $500, provide itemized receipts on request and disclose conditions for advertised prices. The city's Department of Consumer and Worker Protection would publish aggregated average prices for common procedures on a public website, updated at least quarterly, with violations subject to civil penalties of $500 to $1,500.
